about.statementStrong: Vinex Projekt is a Belgrade practice for architecture, urban planning and construction supervision —
about.statementSoft: we believe in the precision of every line and the warmth of natural materials, creating spaces that radiate authority and calm.
paragraphs: Since 2008 we have provided planning, design and construction-supervision services, with one aim: to turn every project into a successful and lasting reality.

Our work includes residential, mixed-use and hospitality buildings in Serbia, Montenegro and Russia — from the building on Politova Street in Belgrade and Espanjola beside the Španjola Fortress in Herceg Novi, to a resort for the Central Bank of the Russian Federation in Sochi.
about.founderRole: Graduate engineer of architecture · licensed urban planner, designer and contractor (Serbian Chamber of Engineers)
about.founderQuote: “An architect should be on the path of meeting people’s most fundamental needs — a place to live first among them.”
